thread:
Jon H: Kicking off provisioning for new org `nimbus-prod`. Need checklist + quota requests for multi-region GPU capacity (us-west1, europe-west1) and networking limits. Can someone own the quota tickets?
Sam I: I can start the quota requests. What GPU types + counts are we targeting?
Jon H: Target initially: 8 x A100 (40GB) in us-west1 and 4 x A100 in europe-west1. We'll reserve burst capacity for Dedicated pool later. Also need static external IP quota (10), regional forwarding rules (5), and VPC peering routes.
Maya R: Noted. Do we have a billing account to attach? Also service account/KMS requirements?
Jon H: Billing: use acct `redwood-ctrl-001`. Service accounts: create `svc-inference-nimbus@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with roles: roles/compute.admin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/storage.admin, roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor. KMS key in us-west1 + europe-west1, key ring `nimbus-kr`.
Carlos V: I'll open GCP quota requests. For AWS, do we want a matching quota set? (p3/ p4 equivalents).
Jon H: Yes — AWS: request 8 x p4d.24xlarge in us-west-2 and 4 x p4d in eu-west-1. Also EFA-enabled ENI quotas (elastic network interfaces) increase + VPC address quota + EBS volume throughput.
Ana P: Tagging policy: all resources MUST have labels: `team=inference`, `project=nimbus-prod`, `cost-center=eng-infra`. Please include those in the ticket descriptions so billing tags get applied.
Sam I: Filing tickets now. Will include rationale, expected steady-state usage, and expected start date (2026-04-15). Any cost estimate to include?
Jon H: Ballpark: A100 reserved pool ~ $12K/month for initial capacity; AWS p4 spot/ondemand mix TBD. Put "proof-of-need" link to load test plan: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nimbus-load-tests
Maya R: Networking preflight: ensure subnet CIDR allocations (10.10.0.0/16 in us-west1, 10.20.0.0/16 in eu-west1), enable Private Service Connect, and request increased Cloud NAT ephemeral port quota if egress heavy.
Carlos V: Quota ticket summary (GCP): GPUs (A100) x12, Static IPs x10, Forwarding rules x5, Routes 50, Cloud NAT ports +10k. AWS ticket: p4d x12, ENI quota +50, EBS io1 IOPS raise. I'll link tickets here once submitted.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket GCP-9876 for GPU and networking quotas. Assigned to Carlos V. https://tickets.redwood.internal/GCP-9876
Sam I: Added labels and cost estimate to tickets. Also CC'ing finance@redwood for spend approval.
Ana P: Quick IAM note — ensure folder-level org policy allows creation of external IPs and service account impersonation from Redwood infra pipeline. I left a policy snippet in the runbook.
Jon H: Thanks. Ownership: Carlos — quota tickets, Sam — coordination and tagging, Maya — network preflight & KMS setup, Ana — org policy checks. We'll reconvene after tickets are approved. :thumbsup:
Maya R: One more: for Dedicated pools, we may want specific GPU image families pre-approved (driver/kernel). Add request: allow machine images `inference-runtime-v2-*` in the account.
Carlos V: Noted, adding to ticket. Will post approvals here when they come in.
Jon H: Great. If approvals land before EOD Friday I'll start provisioning sandbox VMs and a small batch test. :rocket:
